description: A US bank's condition quarter by quarter from its call reports (FDIC, no key): assets, deposits and the share uninsured, loans and the share noncurrent, equity, earnings, ROA, ROE, net interest margin and capital ratios. With no bank, the latest bank failures and their cost.

cert.description: Or the bank's FDIC certificate number.

company.description: A bank or its holding company: ticker, CIK or name (WAL, "Zions").

failures.description: With no bank: the latest failures to list; default 10.

quarters.description: Quarters to return, newest first; default 8.

name: bank_financials

outputSchema.description: rows are quarters, newest first, in the order of columns (dollars in thousands); or failures.rows, newest first.

title: Bank financials (FDIC call reports)
